name: WTT - Remington MSR Realism Compatibility Patch
teaser: I've added compatibility for Remington MSR by Rexana & Realism , hope you like it !
description_html:
My second Mod so far ! I might still make mistakes ( like for my first mod - fixed thanks to community advices ) , if you see some , make sure to tell me in the comments!

The mod simply adds compatibility between the WTT - Armory - Remington MSR by Rexana and the SPT Realism Mod by Fontaine. I tweaked some stats in order to balance to my likings , tell me in the comments if you think something should be slightly changed.

Installation :

- Download the file

- Extract it on the SPT folder or extract WTT - Remington MSR.json in user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\put_new_stuff_here

- Make sure that 1WTT-Armory-Remington MSR mod is loaded before Realism or the patch won’t be applied !
